fulfillments_claim_check.name: fulfillments_claim_check
fulfillments_claim_check.value: "fulfillments"."status" not in ('CLAIMED', 'DELIVERING') or ("fulfillments"."claimed_by" is not null and "fulfillments"."claimed_at" is not null)

fulfillments_delivered_check.name: fulfillments_delivered_check
fulfillments_delivered_check.value: "fulfillments"."status" <> 'DELIVERED' or ("fulfillments"."evidence" is not null and "fulfillments"."delivered_at" is not null)

orders_payment_requires_confirmation_che.name: orders_payment_requires_confirmation_check
orders_payment_requires_confirmation_che.value: "orders"."status" not in ('AWAITING_PAYMENT', 'PAID', 'DELIVERING', 'DELIVERED') or "orders"."confirmed_at" is not null
